Do You Feel It? - Chaos Chaos (Rick's suicide theme)
This song set the perfect mod for the end of that episode. Somehow Rick and Morty pulls off heart-wrenching moments better than high budget "serious" shows

That's because Rick and Morty gives the audience a lot more credit and doesn't protect their feelings from brutal concepts.

It's a lot less about setting the mood as it is just showing the audience something that, by it's very nature, evokes that mixture of sadness/revulsion. Most mainstream shows, by the time something brutal happens, there's been enough foreshadowing that everyone's already girded themselves against it. The possible exception being Game of Thrones, but that's a whole other discussion.

The ending of Rixty Minutes definitely doesn't hold back either. Beth and Jerry's marriage is in shambles and Summer is about to leave home. Beth and Jerry become obsessed with the "what if we didn't get married" situations and their perceived successes....only to find that they would be even more miserable if they didn't accidentally have Summer and get married.

It's a pretty brutal concept to digest.

It's not really brutal in the same way, but also how it always takes a bunch of crazy shit happening and people dying for Beth and Jerry to realize they actually do love each other and want to stay together. Like in Rick Potion #9 and Big Trouble in Little Rick.

Good point. It literally took a killing spree and Summer, Beth and Jerry being the only remaining humans on the planet for them to finally be happy in Rick Potion #9.

Interesting side note...Beth has the constant deep desire for Rick to stay in her life, thinking it will bring her happiness and make her compete, but Rick being gone for good shows that her feelings towards Rick are misplaced.

I almost see it as like a more-fucked-up version of Homer and Marge Simpson's relationship. Where part of the charm is knowing that they really do love each other, even though it doesn't seem like it a lot of the time.
